test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The process of digestion of food in the humans begins in _______ and is completed in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**mouth, small intestine**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Digestion begins in the mouth**, where food is broken down mechanically by chewing and chemically by enzymes in saliva, such as amylase, which begins the digestion of carbohydrates.
 
• **Digestion is completed in the small intestine**, where enzymes from the pancreas and bile from the liver further break down food.
 
• Nutrients are then absorbed into the bloodstream through the walls of the small intestine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Food pipe; small intestine**
 
• This is incorrect because the food pipe (esophagus) only transports food to the stomach; digestion does not start here.
 
• **Stomach; large intestine**
 
• While digestion continues in the stomach, it does not begin there. The large intestine is primarily involved in water absorption and does not complete digestion.
 
• **Food pipe; large intestine**
 
• This is incorrect because, as noted, the food pipe only transports food, and the large intestine does not play a primary role in the digestion process.
